messages:
support_sam: Hey team, customer @carol reported ~92k credits consumed overnight. They say their nightly ingest job hit the embeddings endpoint and their free-trial balance went to 0. Linking logs below.
carol_customer: Yep. We use /v1/embeddings in a background worker that retries on 5xx. We saw a burst of retries between 03:12-03:20 UTC.
carol_customer: Our job is idempotent at app layer but we don't set an idempotency key on calls to Redwood. Could that cause double billing?
dev_raj: Short answer: retries + missing dedupe on our side can cause duplicate requests which consume tokens. But 92k seems high — can you paste a sample request/response?
carol_customer: Pasted: ```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Body: {"model":"text-sim-001","input":["doc1","doc2","doc3"]}
Response 500: {"error":"backend timeout"}
```
support_sam: Also seeing many 202 accepted callback retries in our webhook logs: ingest-bot: delivered callback id=cb_42 failed ack -> requeued. That requeue loop looks like it retried 6-8 times per item.
ingest-bot: alert: callback cb_42 status=failed ack_timeout reason="connection-reset" retries=7
dev_raj: That explains the multiplier. If each failed callback caused the customer to re-send the same embedding payload (no dedupe token), each retry hits embeddings and burns tokens. 
carol_customer: Is there anything we can do immediately? They are on a free trial and this burned their credits.
billing_anne: We can issue a manual credit refund for the trial. I'll need a reconciliation: exact timestamps, org id, and total tokens to refund. Sam — can you capture counts?
support_sam: Working on counts. I have a gid and sample trace ids: trace:tr_789, tr_790, many with identical payload hash.
dev_raj: Immediate mitigation: 1) Ask the customer to pause the nightly job. 2) We can add a temporary server-side dedupe: if same org + identical request body seen within X mins, treat as duplicate and return cached embedding (no charge) for the next 24h. I can push a hotfix to gate retries.
support_sam: Can you scope the hotfix? ETA?
dev_raj: Small change in the embeddings handler + a memory cache keyed by sha256(org_id + body). ~2–3 hours to review + ship to staging, then 1 hour to prod deploy. Will monitor requests.
carol_customer: We'll pause the job now (thanks). If you can confirm refund path that would help our support ticket.
billing_anne: Once Sam sends counts I'll issue a trial extension + manual credit equal to the tokens consumed up to the trial cap. We'll also apply a promo code to top up.
support_sam: Counts attached: total_requests=4,512, unique_payloads=578, avg_tokens_per_request=20 => estimated_tokens_burned=90,240. All between 2026-07-12T03:05:00Z and 2026-07-12T03:25:00Z.
billing_anne: Got it. Issuing refund: 100k tokens credited back to the org, promo_code=TRIAL-EMB-RECOVER applied. I'll confirm in the console and DM the org owner.
carol_customer: Thank you. Any postmortem steps recommended to avoid this?
dev_raj: Recommend: set idempotency-key header per high-level job (we'll document). We'll add server-side dedupe as a stop-gap. Long term: pseudo-ack in callback path so customers can safely rely on webhook acks rather than resubmitting.
support_sam: I'll follow up with a help doc snippet: snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Idempotency-Key: $JOB_RUN_ID" -d '{"input":[...] }'```
carol_customer: That helps. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :relieved:
dev_raj: I'll monitor embeddings traffic and add an alert if we see >5x baseline retry rate overnight.
support_sam: Closing loop: refund issued, job paused by customer, hotfix scheduled, docs updated. Re-open if tokens keep draining. :thumbsup:
